scope: Only a rendered map-selection outline. No spawn, walkability, floor, route, entrance-accessibility, encounter or physical-geography claim.
change_from_hold: The same limited entry-opening convention already approved for WZ02/03/05/11/16 is applied explicitly to the existing WZ04 connector segments; a new independent southwest roof-corner check addresses the prior absence of southwest architectural checking. Original candidate, original hold, controls, transform, source bytes and fourteen vertices are unchanged.
observations: The original closeup shows all four green perimeter corners. Its interior cursor does not cover the west or southwest perimeter hidden by the cursor on the native map.
The original overview independently shows the same rectangle and southwest corner; its Travel Here control covers only part of the southern span, which the closeup supplies.
The two retained PR200 owner views corroborate footprint and gate positions. Their higher-error affine registrations are contextual only and do not determine or refine the approved geometry.
All six fitted architectural correspondences are identifiable. Original H4 remains rejected as a plain edge, and all first-pass B4/B5 picks and corrections remain recorded.

The new southwest check is outside the native cursor. An initial source point above the actual corner was rejected despite a low residual. Independent original-pixel stroke intersections identify the replacement without fitting or modifying the transform.

North connector 1-2 joins the visible line approaches; south connector 6-7 and west connector 11-12 join visible inner shoulders. These are explicitly accepted display-footprint closures, not newly observed continuous physical boundary lines. Gate square/arrow decorations are excluded.
Three native pixels is the same declared raster/manual digitization tolerance used by current approvals. It is not a confidence interval, geographic error bound, or proof of walkability/spawn extent.

new_southwest_check.landmark: Lower southeast roof corner of the stepped building west of Rouge Street, southwest of Wild Zone 04; independent intersection of its vertical and horizontal roof-outline strokes.
new_southwest_check.method: The initial manual source [60,666] was rejected after viewing its enlarged panel because it fell on the vertical edge above the corner, despite a low residual. The replacement uses original-image stroke minima independently in each image, with no homography input: source median luminance across y658:667,x50:70 gives vertical x56; source y665:679,x40:55 gives horizontal y672. Native median luminance across y341:347,x918:936 gives vertical x928; native y345:356,x918:926 gives horizontal y349. Half-open pixel windows; source and target choices fixed before projecting this replacement. No fitted control, transform, or candidate vertex changed.

first_attempt.reason: The source crosshair is visibly above the horizontal stroke; low residual cannot validate the wrong landmark.

new_southwest_check.limitations: Stroke centres differ with raster rendering, blur and perspective. This is an independent image correspondence, not a physical-geography measurement or uniform confidence interval.

accepted_display_connector_segments.historical_candidate_reason: North gate symbol covers a short perimeter span. Straight connection of the two visible green-line approaches is a selection-outline interpretation, not an observed continuous line.
accepted_display_connector_segments.selection_review_reason: The unchanged straight connector joins the two visible north green-line approaches across the gate symbol. Accept it as bounded display-footprint closure under the existing entry-opening convention; no continuous hidden line, traversable entrance or physical boundary is claimed.

accepted_display_connector_segments.historical_candidate_reason: South gate symbol covers the connection between visible inner shoulders. Its arrow tips and filled squares are excluded from the outline; the crossing is unreviewed.
accepted_display_connector_segments.selection_review_reason: The unchanged connector joins the visible south inner shoulders and excludes the gate arrow and filled-square decorations. Accept it as bounded display-footprint closure under the existing entry-opening convention; no route or observed hidden physical edge is claimed.

accepted_display_connector_segments.historical_candidate_reason: West gate symbol covers the inner crossing. The source exposes both shoulders; their connection is unreviewed. This is not a traversable entrance claim.
accepted_display_connector_segments.selection_review_reason: The unchanged connector joins the visible west inner shoulders exposed by the original closeup and excludes the gate decorations. Accept it as bounded display-footprint closure under the existing entry-opening convention; no entrance-accessibility or observed hidden physical edge is claimed.

sensitivity_analysis.scope: Diagnostic alternative fits only; no alternative adopted and no uniform error bound inferred.
sensitivity_analysis.interpretation: Omitting F4 creates a weak alternative with large errors; the independent northeast checks reject it. F4 itself is an identifiable corner and remains in the unchanged full fit. Other omissions and all residuals are retained rather than selectively hidden.

release_effect: One additional reviewed selection outline, WZ04. No roster completion, route, floor, spawn extent, precise pickup, other boundary, live publication or final CI approval.
